past.blurb: The year UDGAM launched High Voltage, an open rock contest for live music and local bands.
Three days of bands, dance, dramatics and fine arts, with Lamhe, the DJ night, to close each evening.
The Lumos Maxima edition, with its splash of colour around the UDGAM emblem.
Vistas Euphoria: 30+ events, acrobatics on the main stage and students from across India.
Bands, solo singers and fashion walks lit up the main stage night after night.
Three days of art, language, food and tradition, opened by a flash mob dancing through the rain.
